description: Negative result for intent i012 (vm-shared-desc-rereads, snapshot s03). Searched drivers/vhost (vhost.c, net.c, scsi.c, vdpa.c, vringh.c), drivers/vdpa (vdpa.c, vdpa_user/vduse_dev.c, vdpa_sim, ifcvf, mlx5, virtio_pci), drivers/virtio (virtio_ring.c, virtio_pci_*), and drivers/net/virtio_net.c for guest/device-writable descriptor tables, virtio config space, or packet headers read multiple times (once checked, once used) without snapshotting into a local. Evidence: (1) drivers/vhost/vhost.c:2881 vhost_get_vq_desc_n() fetches each descriptor once via vhost_get_desc() (vhost.c:1582-1586) into a stack-local struct vring_desc; all validation (head >= vq->num at 2856, i >= vq->num at 2870, loop detection) and use (flags checks, translate_desc of desc.addr/desc.len, next_desc chaining with READ_ONCE on the local) consume only that local copy; get_indirect() likewise copy_from_iter_full's each indirect descriptor into a fresh local. (2) drivers/vhost/vringh.c:332 __vringh_iov() copies each descriptor once into a local and all rcheck validation, iov assignment, partial-split arithmetic, and chain-index bounds checks use that local; __vringh_get_head() single-fetches avail->idx and avail->ring[i] with bounds checks. (3) drivers/vhost/vdpa.c:355-405 vhost_vdpa_get_config/set_config copy the vhost_vdpa_config header once, validate off/len against device config size on the local, and use the same local. (4) drivers/vdpa/vdpa_user/vduse_dev.c:361-460 copies daemon responses once into a local struct before reserved-field validation and request_id matching; config space is kernel-private. (5) drivers/vhost/net.c:692-746 vhost_net_build_xdp() validates gso csum_start/csum_offset against a kernel-private copy filled by copy_from_iter, not the shared ring. (6) drivers/net/virtio_net.c:2275 receive_mergeable() single-fetches hdr->num_buffers into a local (left unresolved only for unaudited fragment-accounting edge cases). No credible shared-memory validate-then-refetch variant exists in the audited paths; findings list is empty with six classified candidates (five safe, one unresolved) and three concrete limitations (bounds of subsystem coverage, incomplete read of vhost_vsock/virtio_transport_common consumers, static-analysis-only with no race reproducer).
